source: Jakeschincariol/linkedin-agent-skill li-post hooks.json (LI-01..21, source order); LI-22+ from sergebulaev/linkedin-skills and liftli/linkedin
evidence: craft; performance notes in best_for are folklore unless labelled
rules: Line 2 is the payoff, not setup.
No '?' in line 1 unless only the user could ask it.
If the hook works with any other person's name on it, it is not the user's hook.
Pick 3 hooks from 3 different formulas, never 3 variants of one.
Examples show shape only; never reuse their numbers.

hooks.name: Contrarian Take
hooks.template: Everyone says {common advice}. After {specific experience}, I think that is wrong.
hooks.example: Everyone says post daily. I posted 4x a week for a year and beat every daily poster in my niche.
hooks.best_for: a point of view (source claims highest comment rate: folklore)
hooks.trap: Being contrarian about something nobody actually believes.

hooks.name: Number Reveal
hooks.template: I {did thing} for {N} {days/weeks}. Here is what actually happened.
hooks.example: I sent 400 cold DMs in 30 days. 11 replied. 2 became clients.
hooks.trap: Burying the number below the fold.

hooks.name: Mistake Confession
hooks.template: {Specific cost} is what {one mistake} cost me.
hooks.example: $18,000 is what not having a contract cost me last March.
hooks.best_for: trust; people forward posts where the author looks bad
hooks.trap: A fake-humble mistake or a cost with no number.

hooks.name: Before/After
hooks.template: {Time ago} I was {low}. Today I {high}. The difference was {one thing}.
hooks.example: 18 months ago I was writing proposals at 2am. Today I send them in 6 minutes. One template did it.
hooks.trap: Three-part transformations; name one lever.

hooks.name: List Promise
hooks.template: {N} things I wish someone had told me before {milestone}.
hooks.example: 7 things I wish someone had told me before I hired my first employee.
hooks.trap: N over 10.

hooks.name: Insider Secret
hooks.template: After {N} years {doing thing}, here is the part nobody puts in the {job posting/course/pitch}.
hooks.example: After 9 years in agency sales, here is the part nobody puts in the pitch deck.
hooks.best_for: credentialed takes; the years must be real
hooks.trap: Delivering common knowledge as a secret.

hooks.name: Callout
hooks.template: If you are still {outdated thing}, stop.
hooks.example: If you are still writing your LinkedIn posts in the LinkedIn composer, stop.
hooks.trap: Calling out a habit nobody has, or contempt for your own audience.

hooks.name: Question Trap
hooks.template: {Specific scenario with a real cost}. What do you do?
hooks.example: Your best client asks for a 40% discount and hints they will leave without it. What do you do?
hooks.trap: An obvious right answer; it needs a real fork.

hooks.name: Story Cold Open
hooks.template:
"{Line of dialogue}"

{Who said it, when, why it mattered}.
hooks.example: "We are going with someone cheaper." That email arrived 40 minutes after I sent my best proposal of the year.
hooks.trap: Dialogue nobody would actually say.

hooks.name: The Receipt
hooks.template: {Screenshot or hard number}. {One sentence of context}.
hooks.example: 3 clients, 11 days, zero calls booked. Here is the exact sequence that did it.
hooks.best_for: provable things (image pairing 'doubles reach' is folklore)
hooks.trap: A number with no story.

hooks.name: Myth Bust
hooks.template: {Popular explanation} is not why {bad outcome} is happening to you.
hooks.example: The algorithm is not why your posts are dying.
hooks.trap: Never naming the real cause.

hooks.name: Comparison
hooks.template: {Expensive} vs {cheap}. {Surprising verdict}.
hooks.example: $12,000 brand agency vs a $20 tool and a weekend. The weekend won.
hooks.trap: An unfair comparison; concede what the expensive option does better.

hooks.name: Permission Slip
hooks.template: You are allowed to {thing reader feels guilty about}.
hooks.example: You are allowed to turn down work that pays well and makes you miserable.
hooks.trap: Generic self-care.

hooks.name: Pattern Interrupt
hooks.template: {One word or three-word line.}
hooks.example: I got fired.
hooks.best_for: scroll stop; use once a month at most
hooks.trap: Overuse.

hooks.name: The Warning
hooks.template: {Common practice} is quietly costing you {specific thing}.
hooks.example: Your 'quick call to align' is quietly costing you six hours a week.
hooks.trap: Fear with no exit; give the fix.

hooks.name: Good vs Great
hooks.template: Good {role} {X}. Great {role} {Y}.
hooks.example: Good salespeople answer the question. Great salespeople ask why it was asked.
hooks.trap: Y is just 'try harder'.

hooks.name: Time Anchor
hooks.template: {Task} used to take me {long}. It now takes {short}.
hooks.example: Writing a week of posts used to take me 5 hours. It now takes 20 minutes.
hooks.trap: An unbelievable ratio (5 h to 8 s).

hooks.name: Unpopular Rule
hooks.template: I do not {widely accepted practice}. Ever. Here is why.
hooks.example: I do not take discovery calls. Ever.
hooks.trap: A rule you break.

hooks.name: Curiosity Gap
hooks.template: The {superlative} {thing} I ever {verb} {broke the obvious rule}.
hooks.example: The best hire I ever made failed the interview.
hooks.trap: The gap is not closed by line 4.

hooks.name: Walk-Away
hooks.template: I {fired/quit/deleted/cancelled} {valuable thing}. {Result}.
hooks.example: I fired my highest-paying client in January. Revenue is up 30%.
hooks.trap: No cost named = theatre.

hooks.name: Direct Value
hooks.template: Here is the exact {artifact} I used to {outcome}. Steal it.
hooks.example: Here is the exact 4-line email I used to reopen 3 dead deals. Steal it.
hooks.trap: Making them ask for it instead of giving it in the post.

hooks.name: R.I.P.
hooks.template: R.I.P. {category}. Cause of death: {mechanism + numbers}.
hooks.example: R.I.P. the cold email. Cause of death: {mechanism with a real number}.
hooks.trap: A category that is not actually dying.

hooks.name: Year-on-Year Pivot
hooks.template: In {last year}, I {humble benchmark}. In {this year}, I'm {goal}.
hooks.example: In 2025, I {humble real benchmark}. In 2026, I'm {goal}.
hooks.trap: A benchmark that is a secret brag.

hooks.name: Odd-Precision Ledger
hooks.template: {$ unrounded figure} {what it paid for}. Every line item unrounded.
hooks.example: $873.47 in API overages last month. Here is the line-by-line.
hooks.trap: Inventing precision; only real invoices.

hooks.name: Controlled A/B
hooks.template: {Action A} -> {outcome A}. {Same action, one variable changed} -> {outcome B}. Same X. Same Y. The only variable is Z.
hooks.example: Same post, two hooks. Same time. Same audience. The only variable was line 1.
hooks.trap: More than one variable changed.

hooks.name: False Binary
hooks.template: Everyone reaches for one of two answers: {A} or {B}. There is a third.
hooks.example: Everyone reaches for one of two answers: a bigger model or more data. There is a third.
hooks.trap: The third option is a mix of the two.

hooks.name: Diverging Curves
hooks.template: Month one, {X}. Month six, {Y}. {Maxim}.
hooks.example: Month one, both teams shipped weekly. Month six, one team still did.
hooks.trap: Curves you did not observe.

hooks.name: Tension Between Two Facts
hooks.template: {Fact A}. {Fact B that should not be true with A}.
hooks.example: Our churn doubled. Revenue went up.
hooks.trap: Facts that are not actually in tension.

hooks.name: Stopped Doing
hooks.template: {N} {months} ago, I stopped {behavior}. {Number, not 'here is what happened'}.
hooks.example: {N} months ago I stopped {real behavior}. {Real number}.
hooks.trap: Line 2 is 'Here is what happened' instead of a number.
